nextStoryContext: US-R1-003 fixed the merge-watch false ci-red bug: GitHub returns mergeStateStatus==BLOCKED while required checks are still pending/in-progress, not only on failure. The old code treated any OPEN+BLOCKED as terminal ci-red, stopping the watch before CI finished. The fix extends PrStatus with optional statusCheckRollup (now fetched via gh pr view --json state,mergeStateStatus,statusCheckRollup), adds hasFailedCheck() that looks at CheckRun conclusion and StatusContext state, and changes the BLOCKED guard: only emit ci-red when hasFailedCheck returns true; otherwise keep polling. 8 new tests added, 1654 tests pass total.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: BLOCKED means one or more merge requirements not satisfied, including pending/in-progress checks. Not exclusive to failed checks. Fix correctly uses statusCheckRollup to distinguish pending from failed.
